projects.title: GloboTech Electronics
projects.summary: Retail sales, customer behavior, and product profitability across stores and regions, 2016–2022.
projects.challenge: Bring sales, customer, product, category, and store data together to help leadership understand performance across an international retail business.
projects.approach: Analyze the linked business tables and present the results through Power BI views covering overall performance, customer segments, store size, geography, and product profitability.
projects.insights: The report surfaces the contribution of large-format stores, repeat purchasing, and high-performing product categories. The repository includes findings and recommendations for portfolio, customer, and geographic strategy.

projects.title: VeraCare Health
projects.summary: Campaign performance and acquisition costs, with recommendations for marketing budget allocation.
projects.challenge: Understand which campaign categories and acquisition channels support customer signups and brand awareness, and identify where future marketing budgets could be better allocated.
projects.approach: Explore campaign, customer, claims, and date tables. Compare signup rates, cost per signup, click-through rates, and cost per impression in a Power BI report and supporting presentation.
projects.insights: The analysis compares the efficiency of email, social media, SEO, and TV, then connects those differences to recommendations on campaign focus and channel allocation. The complete reasoning and presentation are available in the repository.

projects.title: Power Electro
projects.summary: E-commerce sales trends, product mix, loyalty, and marketing channels, 2019–2022.
projects.challenge: Turn underused order and customer data into recommendations for sales, product, and marketing teams at an electronics e-commerce retailer.
projects.approach: Explore orders, order status, customers, geography, and a date dimension. Use dashboard views to examine revenue, average order value, refunds, product mix, and loyalty across time and markets.
projects.insights: The project examines the 2020 sales peak and the subsequent decline, alongside product concentration, loyalty performance, and channel differences. Recommendations and detailed analysis are documented in the repository.
